text:
elaine: Quick broadcast for this cycle 60; deploy moved to Wed 18:0019:00 PT (note time shift). Please block any non-critical merges and no DB migrations this window.

Tom: got it. Is this a full train or service-by-service?

elaine: Service-by-service. Main change: extended canary + stricter aborts due to last week's flake in EU. Canary ramp will be 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with extra validation at each step.

nina: what are the abort thresholds?

elaine: Abort if error_rate >= 0.8% sustained for 5m, or p99 latency up by > 250ms, or api-failure-rate rise > 0.5% for two consecutive 1m buckets. Also block if embedding similarity drift > 5% for any of the test prompts.

alice: we've prepared an auto-fallback to quant-v2 in eu and ap-south; will flip if tokenizer checksum mismatch detected.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: EU region KV cache pressure spike detected earlier today at 2025-03-21T09:04:11Z. Auto-evict and blue-green throttles applied. See /incidents/INC-2025-108.

Tom: is that related to the prefetch job we rolled last week?

alice: yes — a bad prefetch window caused a head-of-line burst. We've reverted the prefetch and increased cache-eviction aggressiveness. Metrics look flat now.

elaine: Given that, ops decision: lower initial canary to 1% and require 20m stable healthchecks before ramping. If stable, proceed with the planned timeline. If not, pause and rollback.

sre: we'll keep aggressive metric collection during the first 45m and run the synthetic prompt suite every 5m. I'll post status in this thread.

elaine: Deploy checklist (pinned in #eng-releases):
```
- NO DB schema changes or long migrations
- Migrations allowed only with DB-owner + infra approval
- Feature flags default OFF on deploy
- Health checks green for 20m before any ramp above 10%
- Canary abort rules enforced automatically by rollout controller
- Rollback endpoint/shortcut validated (ops)
```

nina: I'll run prompt-regression and embed-quality checks during each canary step and report back with snapshots.

Tom: tagging @sre and @alice for extra eyes during the first 30m. Also please keep the concierge smoke lane open for fast manual tests.

ops-bot: PAGER: alice is oncall until 22:00 PT for this window.

elaine: Freeze note 60; library + infra freeze starts at Wed 18:00 PT. Only security/critical fixes with approvals from me + @sec-team. Exemptions need explicit approval thread.

Tom: copying freeze rules. Will pause non-essential merges.

elaine: If you see anything odd, escalate to #incidents and mention me. We'll do a brief post-mortem if we hit aborts. Thanks all, proceed carefully. :thumbsup:
